svg.title: The TL crates
svg.desc: The TL crates. tl-syntax defines the formula graph, profiles and signal catalog, and tl-parse, tl-oracle, tl-mltl, tl-rewrite and filament-mltl all depend on it. tl-rewrite depends on tl-mltl. filament-mltl depends on tl-mltl and filament-observation, and is the single bridge to Filament. Dashed lines are development-only: tl-mltl and tl-rewrite test against tl-oracle, and tl-rewrite tests against tl-parse.

g.data-text: tl-syntax: formula graph, semantic profiles, signal catalog, strict documents
filament-observation: Filament observations to filament-mltl: the bridge to Filament: observations (dependency) (dependency relation)
tl-mltl: evaluates traces to filament-mltl: the bridge to Filament: results (dependency) (dependency relation)
tl-mltl: evaluates traces to tl-rewrite: equivalent rewrites: documents (dependency) (dependency relation)
tl-syntax: formula graph, semantic profiles, signal catalog, strict documents to filament-mltl: the bridge to Filament: types (dependency) (dependency relation)
tl-syntax: formula graph, semantic profiles, signal catalog, strict documents to tl-mltl: evaluates traces: types (dependency) (dependency relation)
tl-syntax: formula graph, semantic profiles, signal catalog, strict documents to tl-oracle: independent reference: types (dependency) (dependency relation)
tl-syntax: formula graph, semantic profiles, signal catalog, strict documents to tl-parse: text to formula graph: types (dependency) (dependency relation)
tl-oracle: independent reference to tl-mltl: evaluates traces: tests (event) (event relation)
tl-oracle: independent reference to tl-rewrite: equivalent rewrites: tests (event) (event relation)
tl-parse: text to formula graph to tl-rewrite: equivalent rewrites: tests (event) (event relation)
